scripts.dev: bunx dotenvx run -f .env.development -- bun run --watch src/main.ts
scripts.build: mkdirp ./db && bun build --minify --sourcemap src/main.ts --target bun --outdir ./dist && bun run sentry:sourcemaps
scripts.refresh-commands:dev: bunx dotenvx run -f .env.development -- bun run src/refreshCommands.ts
scripts.refresh-commands:prod: bunx dotenvx run -f .env.production -- bun run src/refreshCommands.ts
scripts.delete-commands:dev: bunx dotenvx run -f .env.development -- bun run src/deleteCommands.ts
scripts.delete-commands:prod: bunx dotenvx run -f .env.production -- bun run src/deleteCommands.ts
scripts.get-data: bun run refresh:reference-data && bun run refresh:hoboleaks
scripts.sentry:sourcemaps: sentry-cli sourcemaps inject --org jb-codecorsair --project star-kitten ./dist && sentry-cli sourcemaps upload --org jb-codecorsair --project star-kitten ./dist
